name: ather-automata
description: Ather Automata: what needs you and what is next in every S2 session and web app repository (Plan, Build, Prove, Ship), a newcomer tour, autonomy windows, and guards that catch false build passes and lost merge edits.

briefGate.title: Worker brief gate
briefGate.description: What happens when a worker brief lacks paths, acceptance checks or the shared-tree rule: warn adds a reminder, enforce refuses the Agent call, off does nothing. Read-only agents (Explore, Plan) are never gated.

claimGuard.title: Claim guard
claimGuard.description: on: a reply (or a worker's) that says a build, tests, a type check or lint pass, when the latest run of that check this session failed, ran before a later edit, or never ran, is sent back once to run it or say it is untested. off: replies are never sent back (a failing check still shows above the prompt).
